svg.title: Data flow / application modules
svg.desc: Modular level 1 DFD covering capture, history, analytics, guidance, PDF export, preferences, and Android backup/recovery.
svg.text: Level 1 / seven implemented processes / repeated actor and store IDs represent the same objects
Rounded = process / blue = local store or bundled data / square = external entity
Single image or six grid cells
Plant gate > crop gate > disease model
Station; month; upland choice; link request
app_metadata; scan tags for initial seed
Replace rows and restore image files
D1 = scan_history + app_metadata + scan_history_images/. D2-D4 are bundled read-only resources; derived forecasts and PDFs have no SQL tables.
Scan changes refresh the home / analytics views. Seasonal selections are session-only. The bundled forecasting model has synthetic_demo provenance.
